    "from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier\n",
    "from sklearn.preprocessing import OrdinalEncoder, LabelEncoder\n",
    "df = pd.read_excel(\"/Users/jhessiffer/Documents/generated_datasets.xlsx\", sheet_name=0)\n",
    "X = df[['Weld_speed', 'Arc_voltage', 'Current', 'Gas_flow_rate', 'Material_type',\n",
    "        'Plate_thickness', 'Operator_ID', 'Welding_process', 'Ambient_temp']]\n",
    "y = df['Weld_quality']\n",
    "cat_cols = ['Material_type', 'Welding_process']\n",
    "oe = OrdinalEncoder(handle_unknown='use_encoded_value', unknown_value=-1)\n",
    "X[cat_cols] = oe.fit_transform(X[cat_cols])\n",
    "le_y = LabelEncoder()\n",
    "y_encoded = le_y.fit_transform(y)\n",
    "model = DecisionTreeClassifier()\n",
    "model.fit(X, y_encoded)\n",
    "new_input = [49.96, 18.92, 214.39, 22.96, 'Aluminium', 11.38, 57.86, 'FCAW', 19.87]\n",
    "new_input_df = pd.DataFrame([new_input], columns=X.columns)\n",
    "new_input_df[cat_cols] = oe.transform(new_input_df[cat_cols])  # Safe encoding\n",
    "prediction_encoded = model.predict(new_input_df)\n",
    "prediction = le_y.inverse_transform(prediction_encoded)\n",
    "print(\"Prediction:\", prediction[0])"
   ]
  },

    "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier\n",
    "from sklearn.preprocessing import OrdinalEncoder, LabelEncoder\n",
    "df = pd.read_excel(\"/Users/jhessiffer/Documents/generated_datasets.xlsx\", sheet_name=0)\n",
    "X = df[['Weld_speed', 'Arc_voltage', 'Current', 'Gas_flow_rate', 'Material_type',\n",
    "        'Plate_thickness', 'Operator_ID', 'Welding_process', 'Ambient_temp']]\n",
    "y = df['Weld_quality']\n",
    "cat_cols = ['Material_type', 'Welding_process']\n",
    "oe = OrdinalEncoder(handle_unknown='use_encoded_value', unknown_value=-1)\n",
    "X[cat_cols] = oe.fit_transform(X[cat_cols])\n",
    "le_y = LabelEncoder()\n",
    "y_encoded = le_y.fit_transform(y)\n",
    "model =RandomForestClassifier()\n",
    "model.fit(X, y_encoded)\n",
    "new_input = [49.96, 18.92, 214.39, 22.96, 'Aluminium', 11.38, 57.86, 'FCAW', 19.87]\n",
    "new_input_df = pd.DataFrame([new_input], columns=X.columns)\n",
    "new_input_df[cat_cols] = oe.transform(new_input_df[cat_cols]) \n",
    "prediction_encoded = model.predict(new_input_df)\n",
    "prediction = le_y.inverse_transform(prediction_encoded)\n",
    "print(\"Prediction:\", prediction[0])"
   ]
  },

    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"

    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "df = pd.read_excel('/Users/jhessiffer/Documents/generated_datasets.xlsx', sheet_name='Weld_Quality')\n",
    "process_counts = df['Welding_process'].value_counts()\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))\n",
    "plt.pie(process_counts, labels=process_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=140)\n",
    "plt.title('Distribution of Welding Processes')\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
